spanish: O cuando volviere la carne la viva y se volviere a blanco, y vendrá al sacerdote.

findings.issue: The conjunction is unmarked for sense; "cuando" selects a temporal reading.
Both forms are sequential perfects, yet one stands in the subjunctive under "cuando" and the other in the future indicative.
findings.spanishSpan: se volviere a blanco, y vendrá

notes: Participants, number, and the return, turn-white, and come sequence stay inside the tokens.
